transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Um, thank you for seeing me. I, well, I guess I'm here because... I just haven't been feeling like myself lately. I don't want to take up too much of your time, but I just have this constant feeling that everything going wrong at work or at home is somehow my fault. 

Like, I'm a business operations specialist, and I just feel like I'm doing a terrible job. And I just bought a house, but I keep thinking I'm a bad homeowner and I'm going to lose it all, and that I probably deserve to. I know it sounds silly, and I'm sure it's just stress, but... is it normal to feel this guilty all the time? I hope it's okay that I brought this up.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I definitely don't want you to think I'm just this anxious mess who can't handle everyday life. I really try to stay on top of things. 

It's not really that I worry about a bunch of different, random stuff... it's more just that heavy feeling I mentioned, where I'm just convinced I'm messing up the specific things I'm responsible for. But I don't sit around panicking about everything in the world, I promise. I hope I'm explaining that right... is that the kind of thing you were asking?
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um, well... I hate to use a strong word like depressed, because I really try to keep a good attitude, you know? I don't want to sound like I'm just complaining or not trying hard enough. 

But... I guess if I'm being completely honest... looking back on it, this really low mood, and just... kind of losing interest in things... it's been there for almost the whole time since this all started. There have been a few brief periods where I could push through and function a little better, so I'm not totally helpless or anything! I really do try my best to keep going and do what I'm supposed to do. Does that make sense? I hope it's alright that I'm sharing that.
Has this low mood been present most of the time for at least two years?

Um, wow... two years. That sounds like such a long time when you say it out loud. I really don't want to seem like someone who just wallows in things, you know? I've really tried to snap out of it. 

But, um... if I'm thinking about it, I guess... yeah. It's probably been about two years and maybe a month since I really started feeling this way—just this heavy sadness and not caring about things I used to like. I know I should have figured out how to handle it better by now, and I'm really sorry if I let it go on too long before getting help. I hope it doesn't make me sound like a lost cause... is it okay that I waited this long to talk to someone?
During this time, have there been periods when your depression felt much worse than usual?

Um... well... I don't think so? I mean, I really try to just keep things steady, you know? I don't want to make it sound like I'm constantly having these huge, dramatic breakdowns or anything. I really do try to hold it together and keep functioning for my job. 

So... no, I don't think I've had times where it suddenly got, like, drastically worse. It's just been kind of this... steady, heavy feeling most of the time. I've always tried my best to just push through it and not let it completely take over. I hope that's a good thing? Like, it means I'm at least trying to manage it, right?
